description: Compare two people's Korean Saju charts (gunghap): how their Day Master elements meet, their year animals and day branches (harmony, trio or clash), and whether one brings an element the other lacks, in gentle plain words with a link to the free Saju compatibility page. Use when someone asks "our saju compatibility", "gunghap", "궁합" or "are our elements compatible". Exact pillars from solar terms found with an ephemeris, not a zodiac table. Birth times are optional; without them the hour pillars are left out and the result says so. Takes birth details only, never names or contact details, and stores nothing. It describes tendencies for reflection, never a verdict on whether a relationship will work or last.

them.description: Birth details of the other person, only what the user chose to share. No name or contact details.

birth_place.description: Birthplace as city, region, country, e.g. Austin, Texas, United States. Gives coordinates (and the time zone if time_zone is left out).

birth_time.description: Local birth time, 24-hour HH:MM. Leave out if unknown.

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude, if the city is not found. Optional.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude (east positive), with latitude. Optional.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. America/Chicago. Work it out from the birthplace. Needed with a birth_time unless birth_place is in our list.
